evidence.statement: Forwarder comparisons targeting 10.4 described Enterprise 10.4.4 as current after the official Enterprise release notes documented 10.4.5 on October 30. The repaired report distinguishes that later Enterprise release, the October 21 advisory-specific 10.4.4 floor, and the separate 10.4.2 useACK blockage fixed in 10.4.3. It does not infer receiver, UF exact-package or CVE applicability from the Enterprise release row.

impact.customerScenario: A team selects a Forwarder route targeting the Enterprise 10.4 line.
impact.consequence: The older report can lead readers to conflate the October 21 advisory floor with the later Enterprise maintenance release.
